This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

## 
Where we are going

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

- 
First — Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.

- 
Second — Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.

- 
Third — Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

## 
The channels

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

## 
How the funnel is shared

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

## 
What this role is accountable for

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

Alongside it sit website-visitor-to-lead conversion, owned outright by this role, and the mix of paid acquisition itself: the share of members coming from channels beyond paid search, and each new channel's cost against a defined target before it earns more budget. Lead-to-member conversion is owned by Access and the lifecycle function, and blended cost per acquisition across all channels, paid and non-paid together, sits with the Chief Marketing Officer.

What You'll Do

Paid Media Strategy & Performance

- 
Own paid cost per new member as a quarterly target, understanding that monthly variance in this category is largely seasonal rather than performance-driven

- 
Own budget pacing and allocation across all five channels, shifting investment toward what is working

- 
Lead paid channel diversification: build, test, and scale affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, with a defined budget, success criteria, and scale-or-stop decision for each

- 
Be hands-on in the newer channels: build campaigns, manage partners and platforms, and optimize against member-level outcomes rather than platform-reported leads

- 
Manage programmatic and streaming audio partners as an informed client, including planning, creative requirements, measurement, and incrementality

- 
Direct the paid search specialist on Google and Microsoft: set priorities, review work, and stay close enough to the accounts to audit the work independently

- 
Design and run structured tests of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max, with clear success criteria defined before launch

- 
Plan for seasonality: demand and cost per click vary substantially by month in addiction treatment, and the annual plan should reflect that rather than assume a flat target

- 
Maintain offline conversion tracking and value-based bidding wherever a channel supports it, so campaigns optimize toward members rather than leads

- 
Ensure all paid activity meets LegitScript certification and platform policy requirements for addiction treatment advertising. Meta, Reddit, and programmatic partners each apply their own restrictions

## 
Affiliate & Partner Channels

- 
Build and manage the affiliate program: recruit and vet partners, set terms, track quality, and cut what does not produce members

- 
Structure affiliate and partner compensation in partnership with Legal and Compliance, including EKRA and Anti-Kickback requirements

- 
Hold every partner to member-level quality rather than lead volume, and to our advertising and privacy standards

## 
Website Conversion & Experimentation

- 
Own website-visitor-to-lead conversion as a primary accountability

- 
Build and run a disciplined experimentation program: written hypotheses, pre-declared success measures, and documented readouts including the tests that lose

- 
Prioritize the test roadmap by expected impact rather than by ease or preference

- 
Own the online self-scheduling experience and the forms that lead into it

- 
Partner with the content specialist and design partners on landing page builds and publishing

- 
Partner with the Organic & AI Acquisition team on page changes that affect both conversion and discoverability

## 
Funnel Performance & Measurement

- 
Maintain a view of the funnel from first impression to submitted lead, and know at all times which step is weakest

- 
Establish and maintain a conversion baseline for every step, with methodology agreed with our data and analytics consultant

- 
Report cost per new member and member quality by channel, including channels where tracking is imperfect, and use incrementality tests where attribution alone cannot answer the question

- 
Participate in the standing intake funnel review with Access and the lifecycle owner, bringing the paid and website perspective

- 
Maintain clean attribution between paid and non-paid sources

- 
Report performance monthly against target, and explain variance without being asked

Team & Vendor Management

- 
Direct the paid search and paid media specialists: set expectations in writing, hold a consistent feedback cadence, and develop them deliberately

- 
Manage affiliate networks, programmatic and audio partners, and other channel vendors as an informed client

- 
Maintain a current quarterly plan for the function showing priorities, expected impact, owners, and timelines

You'll Be a Good Fit If You:

- 
Are equally comfortable setting strategy and doing the work. This is a small team, and everyone on it executes

- 
Have built a channel from zero: launched it, measured it honestly, and either scaled it or shut it down

- 
Get genuinely excited by a half-point conversion lift, because you know what it compounds to across every channel

-

-

- 
Are curious about channels you have not run yet, and rigorous about how you test them

- 
Work well inside a shared accountability, where the number depends on teams you do not manage and the only way through is a real working relationship

- 
Are rigorous about testing: the hypothesis comes first, and the losses get reported

- 
Find the constraints of regulated healthcare marketing energizing rather than frustrating

- 
Can say what your team is not doing this quarter, and why

- 
Approach the work with compassion, knowing that a faster, clearer path to care is sometimes the difference between someone entering treatment and giving up

Experience — roughly 5+ years in performance or acquisition marketing, with at least two managing a substantial paid media budget

- 
Channel expertise — hands-on expertise in at least three of the five channels we run: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. - 
Channel building — a record of launching a paid channel from zero and scaling it on member-level or customer-level economics rather than platform-reported conversions

- 
Paid search literacy — enough working knowledge of Google and Microsoft Ads to direct and audit a specialist

- 
Conversion optimization — demonstrated experience running a structured experimentation program, not just making site changes

-

- 
Management — experience directing specialists, contractors, or vendors. Experience managing at least one direct report is a plus

- 
Judgment — sound decision-making in a space with hard compliance constraints around patient privacy, partner compensation, and advertising policy

- 
Operating rigor — can prioritize under constraint and hold a plan while conditions change

Helpful but not required:

- 
Healthcare, behavioral health, or other regulated-category marketing experience

- 
LegitScript certification experience or familiarity with addiction treatment advertising policy

- 
Experience running an affiliate program on a network or platform

- 
Experience with a customer data platform or call tracking tooling

- 
Experience working alongside a contact center or intake team on shared conversion targets

- 
Multi-state or multi-market experience

-

- 
Not an organic, content, or brand role. Organic search, AI visibility, reputation, and brand sit with a peer function.

- 
Not a lifecycle or CRM role. Lifecycle marketing and intake conversion sit with the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which owns the content behind them.

-

- 
Not a role where you can hand the thinking to an agency. Partners and vendors execute; this role sets direction and owns the result.

Compensation & Benefits

The target compensation range for this position is $105,000-115,000. The actual compensation offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job.

- 
Generous Paid Time Off (prorated for new employees) - unplug, relax, and recharge!

- 

- 
12 Vacation days

- 
12 Wellness (Sick) days

- 
3 Floating holidays

- 
9 Company-observed holidays

- 
Jury Duty, Voting Leave, and other forms of paid time off may be available

- 
Eleanor-paid medical and dental insurance plans, with affordable vision coverage - We are a health first company, and we strive to make our plans affordable and accessible.

- 
401(k) plan with 3% match - We are excited to be able to support the long-term financial well-being of our team in a way that reinforces Eleanor’s commitment to equity.

- 
Short-term disability - We understand that things happen, we want you to feel comfortable to take time to get better.

- 
Long Term Disability - Picks up where Short Term Disability leaves off (employee paid).

- 
Life Insurance - Both Eleanor and employee-paid options are available.

-

- 
Wellness Perks & Benefits - Mental Health is important to us and we want our employees to have the accessibility you deserve to talk things through, zen with a mindfulness app, or seek assistance from health advocates

Mindfulness App Reimbursement

EAP with eight face-to-face sessions

Virtual health and wellness visits covered by our medical plan.

Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Where we are

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. How the funnel is shared

Marketing does not own the entire path on its own. This role owns the path from first impression to a submitted lead or call: the channels, the landing pages, the forms, and the online self-scheduling experience. From there, our Access team is the first human point of contact for every prospective member who reaches out, by phone, by web form, or through online self-scheduling. They handle insurance verification, appointment scheduling, pre-visit support, and follow-up when someone misses an appointment. The Access team reports separately to the Chief Marketing Officer, alongside this role rather than within it.

The lifecycle communications that carry a prospective member from inquiry to first visit, including confirmations, reminders, pre-visit content, and no-show recovery, are owned by the Organic & AI Acquisition team, which also owns the content behind them. This role partners with that team and with Access, because paid cost per new member depends on what happens after the lead. A standing intake funnel review brings all three together.

The primary measure is paid cost per new member, and it is deliberately end-to-end: spend divided by members who complete a first visit, not by leads generated. It does not improve by producing more form fills. It improves when more of the people we reach actually enter care.

# Growth Marketing Manager

Location: Remote (United States)

## 
About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

## 
The Role

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to own qualified inbound and drive predictable pipeline growth. You'll be responsible for the channels that generate demand, including paid media, search, answer engines, partner programs, lifecycle marketing, and landing pages.

This role requires someone who can move between strategy and execution, build a consistent testing cadence, and use data to make decisions about where to invest. You'll work closely with the Marketing Lead and Sales leadership to forecast results, improve conversion, and turn marketing demand into qualified meetings.

We're a lean, AI-native team. You'll have the autonomy to build your own workflows, experiment with new tools, and use AI agents to make growth programs more efficient and scalable. Success means owning your number, understanding what's driving it, and consistently finding ways to improve it.

## 
What You'll Do

- Develop and execute a growth strategy to increase qualified inbound and achieve pipeline targets

- Own monthly forecasting and reporting for qualified inbound, working closely with marketing and sales leadership

- Manage paid acquisition across search, social, and community channels, including budget allocation, targeting, creative, and campaign optimization

- Run weekly experiments across landing pages, offers, forms, audiences, and messaging to improve conversion

- Own the path from first touch to held meeting, including speed to lead, scheduling, reminders, and nurture programs

- Improve Numa's visibility across traditional search and AI-powered answer engines

- Turn partner launches, conferences, and roadshows into qualified leads and booked meetings

- Define funnel stages and attribution with Sales, maintain accurate reporting in HubSpot, and ensure pipeline metrics align with CRM data

- Build and optimize AI agent workflows, sequences, dashboards, and queries to automate repetitive work and improve execution

- Maintain a consistent experiment log, communicate results, and use performance data to guide future investments

## What You Bring

- 4 to 6 years of experience in growth marketing or demand generation, including at least 2 years directly owning a lead or pipeline target

- A data-driven approach to decision-making, with the ability to build reports, write queries, analyze funnel performance, and distinguish meaningful signals from noise

- A strong experimentation mindset. You test frequently, learn quickly, and know when to stop investing in underperforming campaigns

- Hands-on experience with HubSpot and paid acquisition platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn

- Experience improving conversion across the marketing funnel, from initial engagement through booked and held meetings

- The ability to forecast performance, explain results, and make clear recommendations to marketing and sales leadership

- Strong execution skills and the ability to prioritize progress, measurement, and iteration over perfection

- An AI-native approach to work, using AI tools and agents to build workflows, automate tasks, and improve efficiency

- The ability to operate independently, take ownership of results, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment

## Nice To Have

- Experience at a startup or high-growth technology company where you built a marketing channel or program from the ground up

- Experience marketing to automotive dealerships or another vertical where individual accounts represent significant business value

- Experience running partner or channel marketing programs

- Working knowledge of answer engine optimization (AEO)

## What Success Looks Like

- Consistently grow qualified inbound quarter over quarter while maintaining lead quality and Sales' confidence in the pipeline

- Increase the percentage of booked meetings that become held meetings

- Maintain accurate funnel reporting and attribution that aligns with CRM data

- Establish a steady cadence of experiments that produce clear learnings and measurable conversion improvements

- Build scalable growth programs and AI-powered workflows that improve marketing efficiency

## Why Join Numa

- We believe in everyone's growth

- Be part of an industry leader named the #1 fastest-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000

- Help bring category-defining AI technology to an industry undergoing significant change

- Join a high-growth organization with opportunities to make a meaningful impact and grow your career

## Compensation & Benefits

- Base salary: $120,000 - $150,000

- Equity package

- Flexible PTO

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- 401(k) plan

At Numa, you'll have the opportunity to build the growth engine behind technology that's transforming the automotive industry. If you enjoy taking ownership, experimenting to find what works, and turning data into measurable business results, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll work closely with the Marketing Lead and Sales leadership to forecast results, improve conversion, and turn marketing demand into qualified meetings.

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and paid acquisition platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn
  • Experience improving conversion across the marketing funnel, from initial engagement through booked and held meetings
  • The ability to forecast performance, explain results, and make clear recommendations to marketing and sales leadership
  • Strong execution skills and the ability to prioritize progress, measurement, and iteration over perfection
  • An AI-native approach to work, using AI tools and agents to build workflows, automate tasks, and improve efficiency
  • The ability to operate independently, take ownership of results, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment

  • Experience at a startup or high-growth technology company where you built a marketing channel or program from the ground up
  • Experience marketing to automotive dealerships or another vertical where individual accounts represent significant business value
  • Experience running partner or channel marketing programs

  • Maintain accurate funnel reporting and attribution that aligns with CRM data
  • Establish a steady cadence of experiments that produce clear learnings and measurable conversion improvements
  • Build scalable growth programs and AI-powered workflows that improve marketing efficiency

  • Be part of an industry leader named the #1 fastest-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000
  • Help bring category-defining AI technology to an industry undergoing significant change

raw.title: Demand Generation Manager
raw.description:
CyberSheath Services International LLC is a rapidly growing Managed Services Provider primarily focused on providing Cybersecurity services to the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). We are excited to be expanding our staff due to our growth and are looking to add a Marketing Generalist to our team!

CyberSheath integrates compliance and threat mitigation efforts and eliminates redundant security practices that don't improve and, in fact, may weaken an organization's security posture. Our professionals tell clients where to stop spending, where to invest, and how to take what they are already doing and integrate it in a way that delivers improved security.

Successful candidates for CyberSheath are self-motivated, think out of the box, work, and solve issues independently. Additionally, our most successful people are self-starters and willing to put on many hats in order to succeed. CyberSheath is fast-growing and seeks candidates who want to be part of our upward trajectory.

Position Overview

The Demand Generation Manager will own the strategy, execution, measurement, and optimization of multichannel demand-generation programs. This role will be responsible for converting CyberSheath's market expertise into awareness, engagement, qualified demand, sales opportunities, and measurable pipeline contribution.

The ideal candidate combines B2B demand-generation expertise with strong campaign operations, content instincts, analytical rigor, and the ability to collaborate closely with Sales, subject-matter experts, external partners, and marketing leadership. They are equally comfortable developing a quarterly campaign plan, writing campaign briefs, launching a webinar nurture sequence, analyzing funnel performance, and recommending changes based on data.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Generation Strategy

- Develop and execute a scalable, full-funnel demand-generation strategy aligned to CyberSheath's revenue objectives, ideal customer profile, priority verticals, buyer personas, and sales motions.

- Build integrated campaign plans that create awareness, capture demand, nurture prospects, accelerate opportunities, and support expansion or cross-sell opportunities.

- Define targeted campaigns for key audiences, including DIB owners and executives, CISOs, CIOs, IT directors, compliance leaders, security practitioners, contracts leaders, and operations stakeholders.

- Translate complex compliance and security topics into clear, buyer-centered messaging that emphasizes business outcomes, risk reduction, contract readiness, operational continuity, and long-term compliance readiness.

- Establish campaign themes and content pillars around CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, CUI protection, compliance gaps, assessments, remediation, managed services, and secure federal enclave offerings.

- Partner with executive leadership and subject-matter experts to identify timely market opportunities, regulatory developments, customer pain points, and thought-leadership angles.

Campaign Development and Execution

- Plan, launch, manage, and optimize integrated campaigns across email, paid media, organic social, webinars, virtual events, field events, partner marketing, landing pages, content syndication, retargeting, and other relevant channels.

- Build campaign journeys for prospects at different stages of maturity, from early awareness of CMMC requirements through active evaluation of compliance solutions.

- Develop campaign briefs that define target audience, objective, message, offer, channels, assets, timeline, budget, success metrics, and follow-up requirements.

- Coordinate the creation of campaign assets, including landing pages, email sequences, advertisements, webinar materials, reports, checklists, guides, case studies, customer stories, and sales enablement materials.

- Manage campaign calendars and ensure programs launch on time, meet quality standards, and align with broader company priorities.

- Run A/B tests across audiences, messaging, subject lines, offers, landing pages, calls to action, creative, and channels to improve conversion and efficiency.

- Support event and webinar demand generation before, during, and after programs, including registration strategy, promotional plans, attendance conversion, follow-up nurture, and opportunity acceleration.

Lead Management and Lifecycle Marketing

- Partner with Sales leadership to define and maintain lead-management processes, including lead stages, lead scoring, routing, qualification criteria, service-level expectations, and feedback loops.

- Build and optimize nurture programs that educate prospects, establish CyberSheath's credibility, and move accounts toward sales engagement.

- Segment audiences based on company profile, role, compliance maturity, engagement history, intent signals, customer lifecycle stage, and buyer behavior.

- Ensure leads are routed accurately and promptly, and work with Sales to improve conversion from marketing-qualified lead through opportunity and closed revenue.

- Develop targeted account-based marketing programs for strategic accounts, named-account lists, high-value verticals, and partner-led opportunities.

- Help Sales teams engage buying committees with coordinated messaging and content tailored to business, technical, and compliance concerns.

Performance Measurement and Optimization

- Own campaign reporting and provide clear, actionable insights on performance, including engagement, conversion, qualified leads, meetings, opportunities, pipeline, revenue influence, cost per lead, cost per opportunity, and return on marketing investment.

- Monitor funnel health and identify friction points from first touch through opportunity creation and closed-won revenue.

- Create regular performance reviews for marketing and revenue leadership, translating results into recommendations, priorities, and next actions.

- Maintain disciplined campaign attribution and tracking practices in collaboration with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, and Marketing Operations.

- Use data to reallocate budget, improve underperforming programs, prioritize high-converting channels, and inform future campaign strategy.

- Establish benchmarks and operational standards for campaign performance, audience engagement, lead quality, and pipeline contribution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Sales to ensure campaigns support active pipeline goals, account priorities, field needs, and market feedback.

- Partner with product, service delivery, customer success, and cybersecurity subject-matter experts to create technically accurate, commercially relevant programs.

- Collaborate with content, creative, digital, operations, and external agency partners to deliver high-quality work efficiently.

- Equip sales teams with campaign context, prospect insights, follow-up guidance, relevant content, and messaging that improves conversion.

- Participate in regular revenue meetings to share campaign performance, market signals, lead-quality insights, and recommended actions.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.

- 5+ years of progressive B2B demand generation, growth marketing, field marketing, lifecycle marketing, or integrated campaign experience.

- Demonstrated success building multichannel campaigns that produced measurable pipeline and revenue impact—not simply lead volume.

- Experience marketing complex B2B technology, professional services, cybersecurity, compliance, cloud, IT infrastructure, or regulated-industry solutions.

- Strong knowledge of demand-generation fundamentals, including audience segmentation, buyer journeys, campaign orchestration, lead scoring, nurture strategy, conversion optimization, and attribution.

- Experience using CRM and marketing-automation platforms, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot/Account Engagement, or comparable systems.

- Proficiency with marketing analytics, campaign reporting, spreadsheet analysis, and dashboarding tools.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts without sacrificing credibility.

- Strong project-management skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.

- Comfortable working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

- A practical, test-and-learn mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience marketing cybersecurity, CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, FedRAMP, government contracting, defense technology, or compliance services.

- Familiarity with the Defense Industrial Base, federal contracting ecosystem, controlled information requirements, or regulated manufacturing and engineering environments.

- Experience marketing managed security services, security assessments, compliance consulting, cloud-based security solutions, or managed IT services.

- Experience with account-based marketing platforms, intent-data providers, webinar platforms, paid media platforms, and sales-engagement tools.

- Experience working in a high-growth, private-equity-backed, consulting, managed-services, or B2B technology environment.

- Working knowledge of SEO, paid search, LinkedIn advertising, retargeting, content syndication, and conversion-rate optimization.

- Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, vendors, or marketing technology partners.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Demand Generation Manager will develop a detailed understanding of CyberSheath's services, target customers, sales process, existing marketing programs, conversion data, and go-to-market priorities. They will establish clear reporting, identify quick-win campaign improvements, and launch or refine priority programs.

Over time, success in this role will include:

- A predictable, measurable demand engine that contributes meaningful qualified pipeline and revenue.

- Improved marketing-to-sales alignment, lead quality, lead follow-up, and conversion rates.

- High-performing campaigns that reach and engage DIB organizations with relevant, credible compliance guidance.

- Better visibility into channel performance, funnel conversion, campaign attribution, and marketing ROI.

- Scalable nurture and account-based programs that support long and complex cybersecurity buying cycles.

- Stronger market awareness of CyberSheath as a trusted end-to-end cybersecurity compliance partner.

Core Competencies

- Strategic execution: Connects company growth goals to focused, practical, measurable campaign plans.

- Commercial mindset: Prioritizes pipeline quality, sales outcomes, and revenue impact over vanity metrics.

- Technical curiosity: Learns complex cybersecurity and compliance concepts quickly and communicates them clearly.

- Analytical rigor: Uses data to diagnose problems, make decisions, and improve results.

- Customer empathy: Understands the pressures facing DIB organizations navigating cybersecurity requirements.

- Collaboration: Builds trust with Sales, subject-matter experts, operations, and external partners.

- Ownership: Moves work forward, solves problems proactively, and follows through on commitments.

- Adaptability: Thrives in a changing regulatory and cybersecurity market where urgency, education, and credibility matter.

Work Environment

- Fully remote role, with limited travel to industry events and offsite meetings

- Must be a U.S. citizen residing in the continental United States.

CyberSheath is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

Successful candidates for CyberSheath are self-motivated, think out of the box, work, and solve issues independently. CyberSheath is fast-growing and seeks candidates who want to be part of our upward trajectory.

Position Overview

The Demand Generation Manager will own the strategy, execution, measurement, and optimization of multichannel demand-generation programs. This role will be responsible for converting CyberSheath's market expertise into awareness, engagement, qualified demand, sales opportunities, and measurable pipeline contribution.

The ideal candidate combines B2B demand-generation expertise with strong campaign operations, content instincts, analytical rigor, and the ability to collaborate closely with Sales, subject-matter experts, external partners, and marketing leadership. They are equally comfortable developing a quarterly campaign plan, writing campaign briefs, launching a webinar nurture sequence, analyzing funnel performance, and recommending changes based on data.

- Develop and execute a scalable, full-funnel demand-generation strategy aligned to CyberSheath's revenue objectives, ideal customer profile, priority verticals, buyer personas, and sales motions.

- Build integrated campaign plans that create awareness, capture demand, nurture prospects, accelerate opportunities, and support expansion or cross-sell opportunities.

- Define targeted campaigns for key audiences, including DIB owners and executives, CISOs, CIOs, IT directors, compliance leaders, security practitioners, contracts leaders, and operations stakeholders.

- Translate complex compliance and security topics into clear, buyer-centered messaging that emphasizes business outcomes, risk reduction, contract readiness, operational continuity, and long-term compliance readiness.

- Establish campaign themes and content pillars around CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, CUI protection, compliance gaps, assessments, remediation, managed services, and secure federal enclave offerings.

- Partner with executive leadership and subject-matter experts to identify timely market opportunities, regulatory developments, customer pain points, and thought-leadership angles.

This role will be responsible for converting CyberSheath's market expertise into awareness, engagement, qualified demand, sales opportunities, and measurable pipeline contribution.

The ideal candidate combines B2B demand-generation expertise with strong campaign operations, content instincts, analytical rigor, and the ability to collaborate closely with Sales, subject-matter experts, external partners, and marketing leadership. They are equally comfortable developing a quarterly campaign plan, writing campaign briefs, launching a webinar nurture sequence, analyzing funnel performance, and recommending changes based on data.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Generation Strategy

- Develop and execute a scalable, full-funnel demand-generation strategy aligned to CyberSheath's revenue objectives, ideal customer profile, priority verticals, buyer personas, and sales motions.

- Build integrated campaign plans that create awareness, capture demand, nurture prospects, accelerate opportunities, and support expansion or cross-sell opportunities.

- Define targeted campaigns for key audiences, including DIB owners and executives, CISOs, CIOs, IT directors, compliance leaders, security practitioners, contracts leaders, and operations stakeholders.

- Translate complex compliance and security topics into clear, buyer-centered messaging that emphasizes business outcomes, risk reduction, contract readiness, operational continuity, and long-term compliance readiness.

- Establish campaign themes and content pillars around CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, CUI protection, compliance gaps, assessments, remediation, managed services, and secure federal enclave offerings.

- Partner with executive leadership and subject-matter experts to identify timely market opportunities, regulatory developments, customer pain points, and thought-leadership angles.

Campaign Development and Execution

- Plan, launch, manage, and optimize integrated campaigns across email, paid media, organic social, webinars, virtual events, field events, partner marketing, landing pages, content syndication, retargeting, and other relevant channels.

- Build campaign journeys for prospects at different stages of maturity, from early awareness of CMMC requirements through active evaluation of compliance solutions.

- Develop campaign briefs that define target audience, objective, message, offer, channels, assets, timeline, budget, success metrics, and follow-up requirements.

- Coordinate the creation of campaign assets, including landing pages, email sequences, advertisements, webinar materials, reports, checklists, guides, case studies, customer stories, and sales enablement materials.

- Manage campaign calendars and ensure programs launch on time, meet quality standards, and align with broader company priorities.

- Run A/B tests across audiences, messaging, subject lines, offers, landing pages, calls to action, creative, and channels to improve conversion and efficiency.

- Support event and webinar demand generation before, during, and after programs, including registration strategy, promotional plans, attendance conversion, follow-up nurture, and opportunity acceleration.

Lead Management and Lifecycle Marketing

- Partner with Sales leadership to define and maintain lead-management processes, including lead stages, lead scoring, routing, qualification criteria, service-level expectations, and feedback loops.

- Build and optimize nurture programs that educate prospects, establish CyberSheath's credibility, and move accounts toward sales engagement.

- Segment audiences based on company profile, role, compliance maturity, engagement history, intent signals, customer lifecycle stage, and buyer behavior.

- Ensure leads are routed accurately and promptly, and work with Sales to improve conversion from marketing-qualified lead through opportunity and closed revenue.

- Develop targeted account-based marketing programs for strategic accounts, named-account lists, high-value verticals, and partner-led opportunities.

- Help Sales teams engage buying committees with coordinated messaging and content tailored to business, technical, and compliance concerns.

Performance Measurement and Optimization

- Own campaign reporting and provide clear, actionable insights on performance, including engagement, conversion, qualified leads, meetings, opportunities, pipeline, revenue influence, cost per lead, cost per opportunity, and return on marketing investment.

- Monitor funnel health and identify friction points from first touch through opportunity creation and closed-won revenue.

- Create regular performance reviews for marketing and revenue leadership, translating results into recommendations, priorities, and next actions.

- Maintain disciplined campaign attribution and tracking practices in collaboration with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, and Marketing Operations.

- Use data to reallocate budget, improve underperforming programs, prioritize high-converting channels, and inform future campaign strategy.

- Establish benchmarks and operational standards for campaign performance, audience engagement, lead quality, and pipeline contribution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Sales to ensure campaigns support active pipeline goals, account priorities, field needs, and market feedback.

- Partner with product, service delivery, customer success, and cybersecurity subject-matter experts to create technically accurate, commercially relevant programs.

- Collaborate with content, creative, digital, operations, and external agency partners to deliver high-quality work efficiently.

- Equip sales teams with campaign context, prospect insights, follow-up guidance, relevant content, and messaging that improves conversion.

- Participate in regular revenue meetings to share campaign performance, market signals, lead-quality insights, and recommended actions.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience will also be considered.

- 5+ years of progressive B2B demand generation, growth marketing, field marketing, lifecycle marketing, or integrated campaign experience.

- Demonstrated success building multichannel campaigns that produced measurable pipeline and revenue impact—not simply lead volume.

- Experience marketing complex B2B technology, professional services, cybersecurity, compliance, cloud, IT infrastructure, or regulated-industry solutions.

- Strong knowledge of demand-generation fundamentals, including audience segmentation, buyer journeys, campaign orchestration, lead scoring, nurture strategy, conversion optimization, and attribution.

- Experience using CRM and marketing-automation platforms, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot/Account Engagement, or comparable systems.

- Proficiency with marketing analytics, campaign reporting, spreadsheet analysis, and dashboarding tools.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts without sacrificing credibility.

- Strong project-management skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.

- Comfortable working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

- A practical, test-and-learn mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience marketing cybersecurity, CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, FedRAMP, government contracting, defense technology, or compliance services.

- Familiarity with the Defense Industrial Base, federal contracting ecosystem, controlled information requirements, or regulated manufacturing and engineering environments.

- Experience marketing managed security services, security assessments, compliance consulting, cloud-based security solutions, or managed IT services.

- Experience with account-based marketing platforms, intent-data providers, webinar platforms, paid media platforms, and sales-engagement tools.

- Experience working in a high-growth, private-equity-backed, consulting, managed-services, or B2B technology environment.

- Working knowledge of SEO, paid search, LinkedIn advertising, retargeting, content syndication, and conversion-rate optimization.

- Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, vendors, or marketing technology partners.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, the Demand Generation Manager will develop a detailed understanding of CyberSheath's services, target customers, sales process, existing marketing programs, conversion data, and go-to-market priorities. They will establish clear reporting, identify quick-win campaign improvements, and launch or refine priority programs.

Over time, success in this role will include:

- A predictable, measurable demand engine that contributes meaningful qualified pipeline and revenue.

- Improved marketing-to-sales alignment, lead quality, lead follow-up, and conversion rates.

- High-performing campaigns that reach and engage DIB organizations with relevant, credible compliance guidance.

- Better visibility into channel performance, funnel conversion, campaign attribution, and marketing ROI.

- Scalable nurture and account-based programs that support long and complex cybersecurity buying cycles.

- Stronger market awareness of CyberSheath as a trusted end-to-end cybersecurity compliance partner.

Core Competencies

- Strategic execution: Connects company growth goals to focused, practical, measurable campaign plans.

- Commercial mindset: Prioritizes pipeline quality, sales outcomes, and revenue impact over vanity metrics.

- Technical curiosity: Learns complex cybersecurity and compliance concepts quickly and communicates them clearly.

- Analytical rigor: Uses data to diagnose problems, make decisions, and improve results.

- Customer empathy: Understands the pressures facing DIB organizations navigating cybersecurity requirements.

- Collaboration: Builds trust with Sales, subject-matter experts, operations, and external partners.

- Ownership: Moves work forward, solves problems proactively, and follows through on commitments.

- Adaptability: Thrives in a changing regulatory and cybersecurity market where urgency, education, and credibility matter.

Work Environment

- Fully remote role, with limited travel to industry events and offsite meetings

- Must be a U.S. citizen residing in the continental United States.

CyberSheath is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with a disability.

raw.title: Senior Marketing Strategist & Multi-Venture Growth Leader
raw.description:
CONCORD PACIFIC CORP. | REMOTE | HOURLY CONTRACT

HIRING: MARKETING GURU & MULTI-VENTURE GROWTH LEADER

Senior Marketing Strategist / VP of Marketing / Fractional CMO

Location: 100% remote, U.S. or international

Compensation: hourly rate (please quote your rate)

Engagement: freelance, ongoing potential

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Concord Pacific Corp. is developing and commercializing multiple entrepreneurial ventures across technology, logistics, construction innovation, and other emerging business opportunities. Current initiatives include SPRINTER, an innovative city-to-city delivery and logistics platform, and STEEL ONE, a construction-industry innovation venture, alongside additional projects.

We are seeking an exceptional, highly accomplished marketing guru to work directly with our Founder & CEO and develop high-impact marketing strategies across a portfolio of businesses - not SPRINTER alone. The ideal candidate combines CMO-level strategic judgment with hands-on ability to launch campaigns, create demand, and deliver measurable results.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Develop distinct, commercially focused marketing plans for multiple ventures at different stages of development and launch.

- Translate complex products and new business concepts into compelling positioning, messaging, customer offers, presentations, and campaigns.

- Build brand awareness, customer acquisition, lead generation, and conversion programs across digital and traditional channels.

- Direct paid advertising, SEO/SEM, social media, video campaigns, email/CRM, public relations, and strategic partnerships as appropriate.

- Plan product launches, test marketing channels, define target audiences, establish budgets, and optimize performance using measurable KPIs.

- Build and coordinate a flexible team of designers, copywriters, media buyers, content creators, agencies, and freelancers when needed.

- Report directly to the Founder & CEO with clear priorities, actionable recommendations, and results-oriented execution.

WHO WE WANT

- A proven senior marketing strategist, growth leader, fractional CMO, or VP of Marketing with a track record of measurable commercial success.

- Strong experience launching brands or scaling startups, products, services, or multi-brand businesses; experience across several sectors is a plus.

- Excellent command of customer acquisition economics, performance marketing, positioning, creative strategy, and conversion optimization.

- An entrepreneurial operator who can both design the strategy and execute it - not simply deliver generic marketing plans.

- Confident communicator who can collaborate effectively with an ambitious founder across several active projects.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit a tailored proposal with (1) your hourly rate and availability, (2) a short summary of your relevant experience, (3) two or three examples of campaigns or businesses you helped grow with measurable results, and (4) a brief outline of how you would prioritize marketing across several ventures with different audiences and budgets.

We may begin with a paid discovery and 30-day multi-venture marketing roadmap, followed by ongoing hourly implementation and leadership work. Project scope and weekly hours will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

Company: Concord Pacific Corp. | Current ventures: SPRINTER and STEEL ONE, plus additional projects | SPRINTER website: sprinterone.us

Roman Alexander

Founder & CEO, Concord Pacific Corp.

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: Remote

raw.description:
# Become a part of our caring community
 

CenterWell is seeking a Senior Associate, Digital Marketing to develop and execute data-driven strategies across website, email, SMS, SEO, and organic social channels. This role supports digital lifecycle campaign development, content and website optimization, audience segmentation, performance measurement, and reporting while partnering with creative, analytics, brand, agencies, and other cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate has 4+ years of digital marketing experience, strong analytical and project management skills, and experience working in agile environments; healthcare marketing experience is preferred.

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first.

At CenterWell, we’re transforming healthcare by delivering integrated, personalized experiences that put patients at the center of care. As a leading provider of senior-focused primary care, home health services, and pharmacy solutions—including specialty, mail order, and retail, we’re committed to whole-person wellness: physical, emotional, and social. 

We’re seeking a strategic digital marketing associate to help elevate CenterWell’s digital presence and connect more seniors with personalized care. As Senior Associate, Digital you’ll own and execute digital strategies across key owned channels—website, email, SMS, and organic social—to drive awareness, engagement, and trust.

This role is ideal for a digitally fluent, performance-driven marketer who thrives in an AGILE, fast-paced environment and is passionate about creating meaningful digital experiences for seniors and caregivers. 

Role Responsibilities

- Lead and support digital marketing initiatives and attribution across owned channels: website, email, SMS, and organic social 

- Support acquisition website authoring needs across properties and testing agenda

- Support digital owned performance tracking and assist with key inputs for business listings

- Develop and assist in audience-first campaigns that drive engagement, conversion, and retention 

- Ensure digital efforts are aligned with brand, business, and growth objectives 

- Oversee and contribute to email marketing strategy, including segmentation, automation, and performance tracking 

- Support organic social media planning and execution to foster community engagement 

- Ensure all digital content reflects brand voice, values, and meets compliance standards 

- Partner with internal teams (creative, analytics, portfolio/brand) for cohesive execution 

- Liaise with external agencies and vendors to support digital initiatives 

- Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure timely and high-quality delivery 

- Monitor KPIs across owned channels and compile performance reports 

- Use consumer insights and performance data to inform strategy and ongoing optimization 

Report campaign results and business impact to key stakeholders 

# 
Use your skills to make an impact 
 

Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience

- 4+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a focus on owned channels

- Strong understanding of SEO, content strategy, digital attribution, and user experience 

- Proven success in developing and optimizing digital strategies across email, SEO, website, and social 

- Experience working in agile PODs and applying agile principles to campaign development

- Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills

- Results-oriented leader with a passion for data-driven decision-making

- Skilled in agile environments and cross-functional collaboration

- Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities  

 

Preferred Qualifications 

- Master’s degree or MBA 

- Experience in healthcare, senior services, or multi-site operations 

- Familiarity with omnichannel marketing and audience segmentation 

- Knowledge of HIPAA compliance and healthcare marketing regulations 

Additional Information

This position operates on Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours.

This position may require up to 10% travel.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

 

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

 

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.

 

$86,300 - $118,700 per year

 

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

Application Deadline: 10-23-2026

# 
About us
 

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​
Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first.

At CenterWell, we’re transforming healthcare by delivering integrated, personalized experiences that put patients at the center of care. This role is ideal for a digitally fluent, performance-driven marketer who thrives in an AGILE, fast-paced environment and is passionate about creating meaningful digital experiences for seniors and caregivers. 

Role Responsibilities

- Lead and support digital marketing initiatives and attribution across owned channels: website, email, SMS, and organic social 

- Support acquisition website authoring needs across properties and testing agenda

- Support digital owned performance tracking and assist with key inputs for business listings

- Develop and assist in audience-first campaigns that drive engagement, conversion, and retention 

- Ensure digital efforts are aligned with brand, business, and growth objectives 

- Oversee and contribute to email marketing strategy, including segmentation, automation, and performance tracking 

- Support organic social media planning and execution to foster community engagement 

- Ensure all digital content reflects brand voice, values, and meets compliance standards 

- Partner with internal teams (creative, analytics, portfolio/brand) for cohesive execution 

- Liaise with external agencies and vendors to support digital initiatives 

- Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure timely and high-quality delivery 

- Monitor KPIs across owned channels and compile performance reports 

- Use consumer insights and performance data to inform strategy and ongoing optimization 

Report campaign results and business impact to key stakeholders 

# 
Use your skills to make an impact 
 

Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience

- 4+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a focus on owned channels

- Strong understanding of SEO, content strategy, digital attribution, and user experience 

- Proven success in developing and optimizing digital strategies across email, SEO, website, and social 

- Experience working in agile PODs and applying agile principles to campaign development

- Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills

- Results-oriented leader with a passion for data-driven decision-making

- Skilled in agile environments and cross-functional collaboration

- Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities  

 

Preferred Qualifications 

- Master’s degree or MBA 

- Experience in healthcare, senior services, or multi-site operations 

- Familiarity with omnichannel marketing and audience segmentation 

- Knowledge of HIPAA compliance and healthcare marketing regulations

Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

raw.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
raw.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to elevate our brand presence across digital channels. In this role, you will develop, implement, and optimize comprehensive digital marketing campaigns that drive engagement, increase conversions, and boost overall online visibility. Your expertise in a wide range of digital tools and platforms will be essential to crafting compelling content, managing paid advertising campaigns, and analyzing performance metrics to inform strategic decisions. Join us to shape innovative marketing initiatives that captivate audiences and generate measurable growth!

Duties

- Plan, execute, and manage integrated digital marketing campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Facebook Advertising, and social media channels.

- Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to enhance organic search rankings and improve website visibility.

- Create engaging content for websites, blogs, email marketing, and social media to attract and retain target audiences.

- Manage website content using content management systems like WordPress and optimize site performance through technical SEO practices.

- Design visually appealing graphics and banners using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite for digital ads and social media posts.

- Monitor campaign performance using web analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation platforms; generate detailed reports to track KPIs.

- Oversee paid advertising campaigns including SEM (Search Engine Marketing) and paid search marketing strategies to maximize ROI.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on website management, landing page optimization, and conversion rate optimization initiatives.

- Implement tracking pixels, set up conversion tracking, and analyze data to refine targeting strategies for better campaign outcomes.

- Stay updated on the latest trends in digital marketing, social media advertising campaigns, and emerging tools to continuously improve our strategies.

Requirements

- Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong understanding of SEO tools, SEM, paid advertising campaign management, and analytics platforms.

- Proficiency in website management systems such as WordPress; familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL is highly desirable.

- Skilled in using Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Creative Suite for graphic design tasks related to digital campaigns.

- Hands-on experience with Google Ads (formerly Google AdWords), Facebook Advertising, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation tools.

- Strong copywriting skills coupled with the ability to craft compelling content tailored for diverse audiences across multiple channels.

- Knowledge of web analytics reporting techniques to measure campaign success and inform future strategies.

- Technical proficiency in website optimization techniques including keyword research, performance marketing tactics, and A/B testing methodologies.

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

- Excellent communication skills with a proactive approach to collaboration across teams such as sales, creative services, and IT.

Join us as a Digital Marketing Specialist where your innovative ideas will drive impactful campaigns! We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values creativity, analytical thinking, and continuous learning—all while offering paid positions that recognize your expertise!

Pay: $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Experience:

- SEO: 3 years (Required)

- Digital marketing: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

raw.description:
Lifecycle Marketing Manager

PlanHub is the leading pre-construction SaaS platform and marketplace helping general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers connect and grow their businesses. Built with tradespeople in mind, PlanHub is designed around the user workflow to help boost productivity, maintain deadlines, increase revenue, and create relationships. Easily post projects or submit bids with anytime-anywhere collaboration for every commercial construction trade.

We are hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to help users move from registration to their first valuable outcome, and from there to regular, long-term use.

This is a strategy and execution role. You will define user journeys, build programs directly in HubSpot, own lifecycle messaging and cadence, and measure results. You will also help shape the lifecycle requirements for our planned email platform and user-profile migration.

We are looking for someone who can set direction, build and optimize programs independently, and use data to prioritize opportunities across lifecycle stages and channels.

What you'll do to make an impact:

- 
Define user lifecycle journeys, activation milestones, and progression criteria in partnership with Marketing Operations and Product, with distinct programs for general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.

- 
Design, build, and optimize HubSpot workflows for onboarding, activation, plan upgrades from Basic to Premier, retention, and win-back.

- 
Own lifecycle messaging, copy, cadence, and campaign execution, partnering with Product Marketing and Design on positioning and creative.

- 
Segment and personalize communications by trade, geography, behavior, and plan, working with Product on the signals that make project recommendations relevant.

- 
Plan and manage communications across email, in-app messaging, and additional channels where they improve results.

- 
Run experiments with clear hypotheses, success measures, and appropriate comparison groups to understand the effect on activation, repeat usage, retention, and upgrades.

- 
Build and maintain lifecycle reporting in partnership with Marketing Operations, including cohort and funnel analysis, and communicate findings to Marketing, Product, and leadership.

- 
Lead lifecycle program requirements for the planned email platform and user-profile migration, partnering with Marketing Operations, Product, and Engineering on event definitions, consent and suppression needs, vendor evaluation, and launch validation.

- 
Monitor email engagement, deliverability, and suppression practices, working with Marketing Operations, Product, and Engineering to maintain healthy sending practices.

What you will accomplish in your first 90 days:

- 
Audit existing lifecycle programs, workflows, and data availability, and recommend a prioritized lifecycle roadmap.

- 
Launch or improve activation programs for general contractor and subcontractor users.

- 
Establish a lifecycle dashboard with agreed activation definitions and baseline cohort reporting, including 30-, 60-, and 90-day retention where historical data is available.

- 
Deliver a lifecycle requirements document for the planned migration, including program priorities, required events and attributes, consent and suppression needs, and launch acceptance criteria.

What will make you stand out:

- 
Five or more years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, or marketing automation, ideally in a marketplace, product-led, or SaaS business with a high-volume user base.

- 
Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience, including workflows, lists, properties, segmentation, and the underlying data model.

- 
Strong analytical skills, including cohort and funnel analysis, experiment design, and experience using SQL or a business intelligence tool.

- 
Experience running high-volume email programs, including campaigns and automated sends, with examples of tests you ran and results you improved.

- 
Experience building behavioral and event-triggered programs.

- 
A record of setting lifecycle strategy and personally building, launching, and optimizing the programs.

- 
Strong copywriting skills and the ability to turn product value into clear, relevant customer communications.

- 
Working knowledge of email deliverability, consent management, suppression practices, and compliance requirements.

- 
Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.

- 
Experience with a customer data platform (CDP).

- 
Experience with Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, or a similar orchestration platform.

- 
Experience supporting an email platform migration or implementing new behavioral data and messaging capabilities.

- 
Background in B2B marketplaces, construction, or SMB customers.

- 
Knowledge of email deliverability and compliance requirements.

How we will measure success:

Success will be measured by improvements in activation, repeat usage, 90-day retention, and upgrades and reactivation attributable to lifecycle programs, alongside healthy unsubscribe, complaint, bounce, and deliverability metrics.

What's in it for you:

Join a company that’s just landed on the Inc. 5000 for the sixth year in a row, recognized among America’s fastest-growing private companies. You can make an immediate impact as PlanHub moves to dominate the industry!

PlanHub Offers:

- 
An awesome culture where you will be empowered, make an impact, and learn a ton

- 
Remote friendly

- 
An excellent benefit package, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance

- 
Open time-off policy

- 
401(k) plan with a company match

This role offers a base salary of $105,000 - $120,000 per year, depending on experience. This role also includes the benefits described above, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 401(k) with company match, and an open time-off policy.

This is a remote position open to candidates located within the United States. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor visas or support employment outside the United States at this time.

PlanHub is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

PlanHub complies with all applicable laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company operates. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and development.

raw.title: Valnet | Performance Marketing Specialist - Auto
raw.description:
Summary:

Valnet is hiring a Senior Performance Marketing Manager to directly manage and scale paid acquisition for one or more assigned products within our digital portfolio. This is a hands on role with day to day ownership of campaign execution, optimization, and scaling, with direct accountability for growth, efficiency, and unit economics.

The role is best suited for a performance marketer who operates close to the numbers, understands platform mechanics at a granular level, and is comfortable owning outcomes across spend, revenue, and growth.

Responsibilities:

- Own paid acquisition strategy and execution across paid search.

- Directly manage and optimize campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, with exposure to Meta or other platforms as needed.

- Own relationships and performance management for lead generation partners and marketplaces Valnet works with.

- Manage budgets, forecasts, and performance targets tied to product level unit economics.

- Monitor performance at campaign and product level, identifying inefficiencies and scaling opportunities.

- Design and execute structured experiments across funnels, landing pages, ad copy, and bidding strategies.

- Collaborate with content and SEO teams to plan and prioritize content aligned with product strategy and performance insights.

- Work closely with developers to scope and ship acquisition related features such as forms, landing pages, and tracking implementations.

Requirements:

- 3 to 8 years of hands-on experience in performance or growth marketing with direct ownership of paid media.

- Strong experience managing paid search at scale, including Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.

- Proven track record managing meaningful budgets with accountability for ROI and efficiency.

- Strong analytical capability with fluency in GA4, Looker Studio or similar BI tools, and spreadsheets.

- Solid understanding of conversion tracking, attribution models, and data quality tradeoffs.

- Experience running CRO initiatives and interpreting landing page and funnel performance.

- Comfortable working in fast moving, performance driven environments with minimal process overhead.

- Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and content strategy is an asset.

- Experience in insurance, finance, or regulated lead generation verticals is a strong asset.

Who we are: 
Valnet is a company unlike any other. Here, you’ll work alongside passionate, dedicated individuals who bring their best every day, creating an environment that is as inspiring as it is challenging. We are innovative leaders, not passive followers, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in our industry. We encourage autonomy and value creative contributions, empowering you to shape meaningful change from day one. Moreover, we don’t just talk about culture – we make it our first priority, fostering a collaborative, fast-paced environment where talent is recognized and rewarded. In our true meritocratic structure, your career can develop quickly, giving you the opportunity to grow professionally and be generously rewarded for your achievements. But don’t take our word for it, visit our corporate website to see for yourself!

**This is a work from home position**
