raw.title: SEO/SEM Marketing Specialist
raw.description:
## Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time

Instrumental is growing, and we are looking for an SEO Specialist to help clients become more discoverable, measurable, and competitive across traditional and AI-powered search.

This is not a traditional marketing role. You will combine search strategy with hands-on technical implementation: auditing websites, improving organic visibility, configuring and validating analytics and conversion tracking, and helping clients understand how people find and engage with their businesses. You will also help clients adapt to AI-driven discovery through Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), prompt tracking, and practical visibility measurement.

You will work closely with clients and internal teams to identify opportunities, make or coordinate improvements, and connect search performance to meaningful business outcomes. The work calls for curiosity, precision, sound judgment, and a willingness to explain technical topics in clear, useful language. Search is changing quickly; we value people who can experiment thoughtfully while keeping the fundamentals strong.

## Who We Are

Instrumental is a digital sales and marketing agency based in Golden, Colorado and a proud Elite HubSpot Partner. We partner with growth-minded organizations to build scalable, data-driven marketing and revenue strategies within the HubSpot ecosystem.

We show up unapologetically on our own terms. We lead with authenticity, build real relationships, and deliver exceptional work. There is a bit of Western frontier energy in how we operate. We are self-made, trailblazing, and committed to doing things the right way.

We are not the loudest in the room, but we earn trust quickly. Whether partnering with a Fortune 500 company, a CMO, or a founder building something from scratch, we meet people where they are and lead with a human-first approach. We care deeply about the craft behind a well-built HubSpot solution and the artistry behind a well-told brand story.

Our work speaks for itself. We have earned more HubSpot Impact Awards than any other agency because we stay focused on what matters most, delivering meaningful results that drive real client success. At Instrumental, high standards and strong culture go hand in hand. We support each other, take ownership, and take pride in the impact we create together.

## Who You Are

You show up as your authentic self, grounded, prepared, and ready to contribute.

You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and communicate proactively. You ask thoughtful questions, build trust easily, and look for ways to improve both your work and the team around you.

You adapt your approach to meet people where they are, whether working with founders or enterprise-level leaders, without losing your authenticity. You value both discipline and creativity, and you care about doing things the right way.

You are organized, reliable, and able to balance multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of work. Most importantly, you care about your work, your team, and the impact you are making.

## How We Think About AI

AI is part of how modern teams do great work.

At Instrumental, we expect a baseline of curiosity, initiative, and practical experimentation when it comes to AI. Our team members consistently look for ways to improve how work gets done, whether that means increasing velocity by reducing time to complete a task or elevating excellence by improving the quality, clarity, and usefulness of the outcome.

You do not need to be an expert, but you should be open to exploring and adopting new tools and ways of working. We see AI as a way to enhance thinking, not replace it, and as a key part of building a more intelligent, efficient, and high-performing team.

### Job Responsibilities

### SEO Strategy and Implementation

- Audit websites and search performance to identify technical, on-page, content, local, and authority-building opportunities.

- Conduct keyword, topic, intent, competitor, and search-results research; prioritize opportunities by relevance, business value, and likelihood of impact, not search volume alone.

- Build practical SEO roadmaps and execute or coordinate prioritized work, including metadata and heading updates, internal linking, URL and canonical improvements, redirects, content optimization, and local search enhancements.

- Investigate crawling, indexing, site architecture, mobile experience, Core Web Vitals, image, and page-performance issues; document findings and coordinate fixes with web, development, and client teams.

- Work with sitemaps, robots.txt, Google Search Console, HubSpot SEO tools, and site crawlers to help search engines discover and interpret important content.

- Recommend and support structured data and schema implementation, including JSON-LD, where it helps clarify entities, services, locations, and answers.

- Support website launches, redesigns, migrations, and domain changes by identifying search and measurement risks and validating key technical elements before and after release.

### Analytics, Tracking, and Measurement

- Set up, configure, audit, and troubleshoot measurement across Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, HubSpot, and related platforms.

- Translate business goals into a clear measurement plan: define key events and conversions, document what they mean, and align reporting across organic, paid, referral, and other relevant channels.

- Implement or coordinate tracking for forms, calls, booking or quote actions, cross-domain journeys, and other meaningful user interactions, based on the client’s systems and access permissions.

- QA tags, triggers, events, forms, and conversion paths to confirm that tracking fires as intended, avoids duplicates, and captures the right actions. Investigate discrepancies between analytics, advertising platforms, and CRM records.

- Maintain clear event maps, naming conventions, implementation notes, and change logs so teams can understand what is tracked and why.

- Build or improve analytics views, dashboards, and reports; monitor data quality and explain measurement limitations, consent dependencies, and attribution caveats clearly.

- Connect search visibility and website engagement to leads, lead quality, pipeline, or other agreed business outcomes, and use the findings to recommend next steps.

### AI Search and Answer Engine Optimization

- Develop and execute AEO strategies that help clients improve their chances of being understood, surfaced, and cited by AI-powered search and answer experiences.

- Configure and maintain AI-search foundations in supported platforms, such as brand and business profiles, products and services, ideal customer profiles, and tracked prompts.

- Research realistic audience questions and build prompt sets around client priorities, products, services, personas, and buyer intent.

- Establish AI-search visibility baselines and monitor measures such as prompt coverage, brand mentions, share of voice, citation frequency, sentiment, and referral activity where the platform and data support them.

- Identify content and technical gaps from AI-search findings; recommend useful improvements to page structure, direct-answer content, FAQs, entity information, citations, and structured data.

- Explain the evolving capabilities and limitations of AI-search tools and metrics. Set responsible expectations, distinguish measurable evidence from directional signals, and avoid overstating attribution or results.

- Educate clients and teammates on AEO tools, prompt selection, tracking, and practical workflows so they can participate in and sustain the work.

### Performance, Reporting, and Optimization

- Monitor organic search, website, and AI-search performance; investigate changes and separate actual demand or ranking shifts from tracking, site, or attribution issues.

- Analyze rankings, impressions, clicks, landing-page engagement, conversions, lead quality, and other client-specific measures to identify what is working and what needs attention.

- Produce clear, client-ready audits, roadmaps, dashboards, and performance updates that connect technical work and search activity to client goals.

- Use data and testing to refine recommendations, prioritize work, and communicate what changed, what was learned, and what should happen next.

- Partner with paid media specialists to align search intent, keyword insights, conversion definitions, and reporting across paid and organic programs. Support paid search analysis as needed without assuming sole ownership of paid campaign budgets or management.

### Client and Team Collaboration

- Partner with Growth Strategists, content, creative, web, development, paid media, and HubSpot teams to improve discovery, measurement, and conversion paths.

- Present audits, strategies, and recommendations in a clear, constructive way; help clients understand tradeoffs, dependencies, owners, and next steps.

- Request and verify required access, identify when work depends on client or platform administrators, and communicate blockers early.

- Manage multiple client workstreams, document decisions and implementation status, and follow through on agreed deliverables.

- Stay current on search engine updates, analytics and privacy changes, AI-search behavior, AEO practices, and relevant platform capabilities; share useful learnings with clients and teammates.

### Relevant Competencies You'll Need for This Position

- Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, technical SEO, search intent, keyword and topic research, on-page optimization, crawling, indexing, and site architecture.

- Hands-on experience configuring or troubleshooting web analytics and tracking, especially GTM, GA4, conversion events, and form or call measurement.

- Ability to turn a business objective into a practical tracking plan and validate that the resulting data is useful and trustworthy.

- Familiarity with HubSpot analytics and SEO tools, CRM data, cross-domain measurement, and the relationship between website activity and lead or pipeline reporting.

- Familiarity with AEO, AI-search visibility, tracked prompts, answer engines, LLMs, or a demonstrated ability to learn quickly in this emerging area.

- Understanding of structured data and schema markup, including JSON-LD, and how technical and content signals can support search understanding.

- Analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose data discrepancies, explain limitations, and turn findings into actionable recommendations.

- Strong reporting skills, with the ability to communicate technical and performance information clearly to clients and internal teams.

- Experience with tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, HubSpot, Looker Studio, Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.

- Working knowledge of paid search platforms such as Google Ads, including conversion measurement and the ability to collaborate with paid media owners.

- Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, analysis, reporting, testing, and workflow efficiency while maintaining human judgment and quality control.

- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

- Strong collaboration, project management, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple clients and priorities in a fast-paced agency environment.

- Proactive problem solver who identifies opportunities, flags risks, and recommends thoughtful solutions.

- Adaptable and comfortable adjusting strategies as platforms, algorithms, AI tools, and client needs evolve.

- Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging digital marketing and measurement trends.

### Required Experience

- 3+ years of relevant experience in SEO, search marketing, web analytics, or a related field.

- Experience auditing websites and translating findings into prioritized recommendations or implemented improvements.

- Experience setting up, validating, or troubleshooting analytics and conversion tracking with tools such as GTM, GA4, or equivalent platforms.

- Experience analyzing digital marketing performance and translating data into actionable recommendations.

- Experience with SEO and/or analytics platforms; experience with AI-search or AEO tools is a plus.

- BA/BS degree or equivalent professional experience.

## What We Offer

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Short-term and long-term disability coverage

- Accident insurance

- 401(k) retirement plan

- 15 paid holidays plus generous PTO

- Quarterly incentive plan

- A close-knit, supportive team that genuinely cares about the work and each other

Ready to make search more discoverable, measurable, and useful to client growth?
We would love to meet you.

You do not need to be an expert, but you should be open to exploring and adopting new tools and ways of working. We see AI as a way to enhance thinking, not replace it, and as a key part of building a more intelligent, efficient, and high-performing team.

Job Responsibilities

SEO Strategy and Implementation

  • Audit websites and search performance to identify technical, on-page, content, local, and authority-building opportunities.
  • Conduct keyword, topic, intent, competitor, and search-results research; prioritize opportunities by relevance, business value, and likelihood of impact, not search volume alone.
  • Build practical SEO roadmaps and execute or coordinate prioritized work, including metadata and heading updates, internal linking, URL and canonical improvements, redirects, content optimization, and local search enhancements.
  • Investigate crawling, indexing, site architecture, mobile experience, Core Web Vitals, image, and page-performance issues; document findings and coordinate fixes with web, development, and client teams.
  • Work with sitemaps, robots.txt, Google Search Console, HubSpot SEO tools, and site crawlers to help search engines discover and interpret important content.
  • Recommend and support structured data and schema implementation, including JSON-LD, where it helps clarify entities, services, locations, and answers.
  • Support website launches, redesigns, migrations, and domain changes by identifying search and measurement risks and validating key technical elements before and after release.

Analytics, Tracking, and Measurement

  • Set up, configure, audit, and troubleshoot measurement across Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, HubSpot, and related platforms.
  • Translate business goals into a clear measurement plan: define key events and conversions, document what they mean, and align reporting across organic, paid, referral, and other relevant channels.
  • Implement or coordinate tracking for forms, calls, booking or quote actions, cross-domain journeys, and other meaningful user interactions, based on the client’s systems and access permissions.
  • QA tags, triggers, events, forms, and conversion paths to confirm that tracking fires as intended, avoids duplicates, and captures the right actions. Investigate discrepancies between analytics, advertising platforms, and CRM records.
  • Maintain clear event maps, naming conventions, implementation notes, and change logs so teams can understand what is tracked and why.
  • Build or improve analytics views, dashboards, and reports; monitor data quality and explain measurement limitations, consent dependencies, and attribution caveats clearly.
  • Connect search visibility and website engagement to leads, lead quality, pipeline, or other agreed business outcomes, and use the findings to recommend next steps.

AI Search and Answer Engine Optimization

  • Develop and execute AEO strategies that help clients improve their chances of being understood, surfaced, and cited by AI-powered search and answer experiences.
  • Configure and maintain AI-search foundations in supported platforms, such as brand and business profiles, products and services, ideal customer profiles, and tracked prompts.
  • Research realistic audience questions and build prompt sets around client priorities, products, services, personas, and buyer intent.
  • Establish AI-search visibility baselines and monitor measures such as prompt coverage, brand mentions, share of voice, citation frequency, sentiment, and referral activity where the platform and data support them.
  • Identify content and technical gaps from AI-search findings; recommend useful improvements to page structure, direct-answer content, FAQs, entity information, citations, and structured data.
  • Explain the evolving capabilities and limitations of AI-search tools and metrics. Set responsible expectations, distinguish measurable evidence from directional signals, and avoid overstating attribution or results.
  • Educate clients and teammates on AEO tools, prompt selection, tracking, and practical workflows so they can participate in and sustain the work.

Performance, Reporting, and Optimization

  • Monitor organic search, website, and AI-search performance; investigate changes and separate actual demand or ranking shifts from tracking, site, or attribution issues.
  • Analyze rankings, impressions, clicks, landing-page engagement, conversions, lead quality, and other client-specific measures to identify what is working and what needs attention.
  • Produce clear, client-ready audits, roadmaps, dashboards, and performance updates that connect technical work and search activity to client goals.
  • Use data and testing to refine recommendations, prioritize work, and communicate what changed, what was learned, and what should happen next.
  • Partner with paid media specialists to align search intent, keyword insights, conversion definitions, and reporting across paid and organic programs. Support paid search analysis as needed without assuming sole ownership of paid campaign budgets or management.

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with Growth Strategists, content, creative, web, development, paid media, and HubSpot teams to improve discovery, measurement, and conversion paths.
  • Present audits, strategies, and recommendations in a clear, constructive way; help clients understand tradeoffs, dependencies, owners, and next steps.
  • Request and verify required access, identify when work depends on client or platform administrators, and communicate blockers early.
  • Manage multiple client workstreams, document decisions and implementation status, and follow through on agreed deliverables.
  • Stay current on search engine updates, analytics and privacy changes, AI-search behavior, AEO practices, and relevant platform capabilities; share useful learnings with clients and teammates.

Relevant Competencies You'll Need for This Position

  • Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, technical SEO, search intent, keyword and topic research, on-page optimization, crawling, indexing, and site architecture.
  • Hands-on experience configuring or troubleshooting web analytics and tracking, especially GTM, GA4, conversion events, and form or call measurement.
  • Ability to turn a business objective into a practical tracking plan and validate that the resulting data is useful and trustworthy.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot analytics and SEO tools, CRM data, cross-domain measurement, and the relationship between website activity and lead or pipeline reporting.
  • Familiarity with AEO, AI-search visibility, tracked prompts, answer engines, LLMs, or a demonstrated ability to learn quickly in this emerging area.
  • Understanding of structured data and schema markup, including JSON-LD, and how technical and content signals can support search understanding.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose data discrepancies, explain limitations, and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong reporting skills, with the ability to communicate technical and performance information clearly to clients and internal teams.
  • Experience with tools such as Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, HubSpot, Looker Studio, Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of paid search platforms such as Google Ads, including conversion measurement and the ability to collaborate with paid media owners.
  • Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, analysis, reporting, testing, and workflow efficiency while maintaining human judgment and quality control.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Strong collaboration, project management, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple clients and priorities in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Proactive problem solver who identifies opportunities, flags risks, and recommends thoughtful solutions.
  • Adaptable and comfortable adjusting strategies as platforms, algorithms, AI tools, and client needs evolve.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging digital marketing and measurement trends.

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in SEO, search marketing, web analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience auditing websites and translating findings into prioritized recommendations or implemented improvements.
  • Experience setting up, validating, or troubleshooting analytics and conversion tracking with tools such as GTM, GA4, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience analyzing digital marketing performance and translating data into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience with SEO and/or analytics platforms; experience with AI-search or AEO tools is a plus.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent professional experience.

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • Accident insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • 15 paid holidays plus generous PTO
  • Quarterly incentive plan
  • A close-knit, supportive team that genuinely cares about the work and each other

Ready to make search more discoverable, measurable, and useful to client growth?
We would love to meet you.

  • Investigate crawling, indexing, site architecture, mobile experience, Core Web Vitals, image, and page-performance issues; document findings and coordinate fixes with web, development, and client teams.
  • Work with sitemaps, robots.txt, Google Search Console, HubSpot SEO tools, and site crawlers to help search engines discover and interpret important content.

  • Set up, configure, audit, and troubleshoot measurement across Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, HubSpot, and related platforms.
  • Translate business goals into a clear measurement plan: define key events and conversions, document what they mean, and align reporting across organic, paid, referral, and other relevant channels.

  • QA tags, triggers, events, forms, and conversion paths to confirm that tracking fires as intended, avoids duplicates, and captures the right actions. Investigate discrepancies between analytics, advertising platforms, and CRM records.
  • Maintain clear event maps, naming conventions, implementation notes, and change logs so teams can understand what is tracked and why.
  • Build or improve analytics views, dashboards, and reports; monitor data quality and explain measurement limitations, consent dependencies, and attribution caveats clearly.
  • Connect search visibility and website engagement to leads, lead quality, pipeline, or other agreed business outcomes, and use the findings to recommend next steps.

  • Develop and execute AEO strategies that help clients improve their chances of being understood, surfaced, and cited by AI-powered search and answer experiences.

  • Accident insurance

  • Quarterly incentive plan
  • A close-knit, supportive team that genuinely cares about the work and each other

We would love to meet you.

raw.title: Lead Paid Search Strategist
raw.description:
The Lead Paid Search Strategist position is a senior level, client-facing role within 829’s Marketing Services department. This position is ideal for someone who is proactive, a great communicator, analytical, and willing to go the extra mile to get your work completed at a high level. You’ll manage a portfolio of our largest, enterprise clients, executing campaigns and coordinating with colleagues across marketing disciplines to drive collective success.

This role provides the opportunity not only to dive deep into paid ads, but also learn on a broader scope about different areas of 829’s marketing business. You’ll also have the opportunity to mentor and coach junior colleagues and peers - and if interested - manage direct reports over time. We’re growing fast and seeking passionate marketers who want to grow with our team and organization.

What You'll Do

- 

Strategize, develop, and simultaneously maintain multiple digital advertising campaigns for a portfolio of enterprise sized businesses.

- 

Monitor the effectiveness of campaigns as they relate to client goals, conversions, and events.

- 

Update clients regularly as to the status of their digital initiatives.

- 

Prepare client deliverables from project kickoff documents to rolling reporting.

- 

Develop and outline projections and forecasting for client executive teams early and continuously within engagements.

- 

Advise clients on how to best accomplish their business goals through digital advertising.

- 

Present effectively to day to day client POCs as well as client executive and board team members, tailoring presentations respectively to different levels within their organization.

- 

Serve as a technical resource to other departments, committees, and your peers.

- 

Conceptualize, vocalize, and implement departmental process improvements.

- 

Assist with candidate interviews and the departmental hiring process.

- 

Onboard, coach, and supervise one or more junior reports, if interested.

What You'll Bring

- 

A minimum of 6-8 years managing paid advertising programs, preferably in an agency setting.

- 

Thorough understanding of various paid advertising tool sets such as Google Ads and Facebook Ads.

- 

Proficiency in Google Sheets, Google Slides, and Google Docs.

- 

Deep understanding of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Hubspot Analytics, or similar.

- 

Understanding of landing page best practices and optimization techniques.

- 

Experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, or Monday.com.

- 

Experience with pixeling and conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager or other means.

- 

Experience with reporting tools such as Google Data Studio, NinjaCat, TapClicks, or similar.

- 

Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.

- 

Exceptional time management and organization skills.

- 

Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented environment.

- 

Experience juggling multiple projects and paid advertising campaigns simultaneously.

Nice-to-Haves:

- 

Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS.

- 

Bing Ads certification(s).

- 

Programmatic experience.

- 

Experience training and mentoring more junior team members.

Benefits and Perks We Provide

- 

Remote Workplace. You have the option to work at our office in Boston or remotely in one of these states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, ID, IL, KY, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NV, NH, NJ, NY, NC, SC, OH, OK, PA, RI, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA.

- 

Paid Time Off. Receive generous paid vacation benefits that increase each year you’re with us, 14 Company Holidays, and Summer Fridays from Memorial Day through Labor Day.

- 

401K + Match. 401K plan with 4% Safe Harbor employer match after one year of employment and financial literacy services provided through our retirement provider.

- 

Life Insurance Benefit. No-cost coverage to ensure peace of mind for your family.

- 

Short Term Disability Benefit. We've got you covered if you need to be OOO with an illness or injury that keeps you out of work.

- 

Healthcare. Choose from several competitive healthcare plans for you and your family with 80% employer coverage for all medical and dental premiums, 100% employer coverage for vision, and the option to participate in the FSA program.

- 

Commuter Benefits. Allocate pre-tax funds towards your commute to save up to 40% per year in transportation expenses.

- 

Continuing Education. Access to monthly team-led webinars, exclusive 829-cohort based learning, digital course platforms, and funding opportunities to attend national conferences and events.

What We Believe

At 829 Studios, we boldly embrace diversity, inclusivity, and equal opportunity. Our goal: a team rich in backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. Why? Because inclusivity powers our brilliance and client success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, religion, creed, color, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, mental illness, age, ancestry, genetic information, military service, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Who We Are

829 Studios is a Boston-based integrated digital marketing agency with a mission to propel organizations to unlock their full potential and accomplish their most ambitious goals. We harness the power of logic with magic – a balance of data-driven strategy and brand-focused creative. We partner with diverse organizations across various industries and our client list encompasses venture-backed start-ups, publicly traded companies, non-profits, and more. By committing not only to our growth as a company, but the development of our employees and teams’, we have created a collaborative environment that fosters ingenuity and promotes diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging values within our community. 829 has been recognized as one of the nation’s top agencies by the Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Privately Held Companies, Adweek 100 Fastest-Growing Digital Agencies, Boston Business Journal's Fast 50 (Massachusetts' 50 Fastest-Growing Private Companies), HubSpot's Top Digital Agencies list, and a we are and employee-certified Great Place to Work.

Salary Range: $90,000-$110,000

We determine compensation based on experience, demonstrated skills, and current market conditions at the time of hire to ensure fairness and consistency across roles. Actual compensation will depend on experience and may be adjusted based on skills, qualifications, and alignment with the scope and impact of the role.

raw.title: E-Commerce Manager
raw.description:
E-Commerce Manager – Job Description

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and results-driven E-Commerce Manager to manage and grow our Shopify store. The ideal candidate has strong Shopify backend experience, understands website conversion optimization, is comfortable using AI tools, and can manage Klaviyo email marketing campaigns.

The primary goal of this position is to increase online sales, improve conversion rates, and continuously optimize the customer shopping experience.

1. Shopify Website Management

- Manage and maintain the Shopify website and backend.

- Continuously improve website layout, design, navigation, and user experience.

- Optimize product pages, descriptions, images, collections, and product displays to increase sales.

- Ensure products are presented in a visually appealing and professional way.

- Improve homepage, landing pages, and promotional sections.

- Manage product launches, promotions, discounts, and website updates.

- Ensure the website performs well on desktop and mobile devices.

- Identify and resolve website issues, broken links, and checkout problems.

2. Conversion Rate Optimization & Sales Growth

- Analyze website performance and identify opportunities to increase conversion rates.

- Monitor key metrics, including conversion rate, average order value (AOV), revenue, traffic, and cart abandonment.

- Use Shopify Analytics, Google Analytics (GA4), and other reporting tools.

- Identify underperforming products and pages and recommend improvements.

- Conduct A/B testing on product pages, landing pages, and website elements.

- Improve upselling, cross-selling, product recommendations, and bundling strategies.

- Optimize the customer journey from homepage to checkout.

- Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.

3. Klaviyo Email & SMS Marketing

- Manage Klaviyo automated flows.

- Work closely with the graphic designer to create visually appealing, sales-driven emails.

- Execute promotional campaigns, product launches, and seasonal sales.

- Build and optimize automated email flows, including welcome series, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, and post-purchase emails.

- Segment customer lists to improve targeting and campaign performance.

- Monitor email performance, including open rates, click rates, conversion rates, and revenue generated.

- Conduct A/B testing on subject lines, email designs, offers, and messaging.

- Develop strategies to grow the email subscriber list and increase customer lifetime value.

- Ensure email and SMS campaigns follow applicable marketing and privacy requirements.

4. AI Tools & Website Optimization

- Have hands-on experience using AI tools to improve e-commerce performance.

- Use AI to analyze website metrics, customer behavior, and sales trends.

- Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates using AI-powered insights.

- Use AI tools to improve product descriptions, SEO content, and marketing copy.

- Research and implement useful Shopify AI apps and automation tools.

- Stay updated on new AI technologies that can improve sales, efficiency, and customer experience.

- Use AI to streamline repetitive tasks and improve marketing productivity.

5. Technical Stack Management 

- Experience with Rebuy, Recharge, Loyalty Lion, Gorgias and other Integrations

- Oversight of these integrations, including regular meetings with account reps to ensure company’s set up is optimized

6. Creative & Marketing Coordination

- Work closely with graphic designers to develop website banners, promotional graphics, and email campaigns.

- Provide clear creative direction based on sales goals and performance data.

- Coordinate website updates with new product launches and marketing campaigns.

- Ensure consistent branding and a premium visual presentation across the website.

- Review creative assets and recommend changes that could improve customer engagement and sales.

- Coordinate with the marketing team to ensure advertising campaigns align with website landing pages and promotions.

7. SEO & Website Performance

- Collaborate with google consultant to optimize product pages, collections, and website content for search engines.

- Monitor website speed, mobile usability, and technical performance.

- Manage Shopify apps and integrations to ensure they support website performance.

- Identify opportunities to improve product discoverability and internal search results.

8. Reporting & Accountability

- Monitor website sales and performance daily.

- Prepare weekly reports covering sales, conversion rates, traffic, and email marketing results.

- Identify what is working, what is underperforming, and what needs improvement.

- Recommend and implement actionable strategies to increase revenue.

- Track results of website changes and marketing campaigns.

- Take ownership of e-commerce performance and continuously look for growth opportunities.

Required Skills & Experience

- Proven experience managing and growing a Shopify e-commerce store.

- Strong knowledge of Shopify backend, themes, apps, and analytics.

- Hands-on experience with Klaviyo email marketing and automation.

- Experience using AI tools for e-commerce, marketing, and data analysis.

- Strong understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO).

- Knowledge about Google Analytics 4 and performance reporting.

- Knowledge of SEO, product merchandising, and online customer behavior.

- Ability to work with graphic designers and coordinate creative projects.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to turn data into actionable improvements.

- Excellent organization, communication, and project management skills.

- Self-motivated, proactive, and focused on measurable sales results.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with beauty, cosmetics, or professional beauty e-commerce brands.

- Experience with Shopify Plus.

- Familiarity with subscription programs, loyalty programs, and customer retention strategies.

- Experience with landing page builders, heatmaps, and A/B testing tools.

- Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid.

- Experience coordinating with paid advertising teams to improve campaign conversions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this position will be measured by:

- Revenue Growth: Increasing Shopify store sales.

- Conversion Rate: Improving the percentage of website visitors who purchase.

- Average Order Value: Increasing the average customer purchase amount.

- Email Revenue: Growing revenue generated through Klaviyo.

- Customer Retention: Increasing repeat purchases and customer lifetime value.

- Website Performance: Improving speed, usability, and shopping experience.

- Continuous Improvement: Regularly testing and implementing changes that deliver measurable results.

Our expectation: This person should not simply maintain the website. They should actively analyze performance, identify opportunities, propose improvements, and take initiative to grow online sales.

This position is for full-time, salaried employment, but we are open to an independent contractor if applicant prefers.

Pay: Up to $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

- 401(k)

- Dental insurance

Work Location: Remote

- Strong understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO).

- Knowledge of SEO, product merchandising, and online customer behavior.

- Ability to work with graphic designers and coordinate creative projects.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to turn data into actionable improvements.

- Excellent organization, communication, and project management skills.

- Self-motivated, proactive, and focused on measurable sales results.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with beauty, cosmetics, or professional beauty e-commerce brands.

- Experience with Shopify Plus.

- Familiarity with subscription programs, loyalty programs, and customer retention strategies.

- Experience with landing page builders, heatmaps, and A/B testing tools.

- Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid.

- Experience coordinating with paid advertising teams to improve campaign conversions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this position will be measured by:

- Revenue Growth: Increasing Shopify store sales.

- Conversion Rate: Improving the percentage of website visitors who purchase.

- Average Order Value: Increasing the average customer purchase amount.

- Email Revenue: Growing revenue generated through Klaviyo.

- Customer Retention: Increasing repeat purchases and customer lifetime value.

- Website Performance: Improving speed, usability, and shopping experience.

- Continuous Improvement: Regularly testing and implementing changes that deliver measurable results.

Our expectation: This person should not simply maintain the website. They should actively analyze performance, identify opportunities, propose improvements, and take initiative to grow online sales.

This position is for full-time, salaried employment, but we are open to an independent contractor if applicant prefers.

Pay: Up to $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

- 401(k)

- Dental insurance

Work Location: Remote

raw.description:
Technical Marketing Manager

Team: Siemens, Data Centers & AI Factories, Marketing & Communications

Location: U.S. Remote (access to a major U.S. airport)

Transform the everyday with us! At Siemens, we combine the real and digital worlds to enable sustainable progress. Our global, diverse team puts people first, supporting and challenging you to grow in new ways.

Role Overview

The Technical Marketing Manager bridges technical development and commercial go-to-market strategy for our Data Centers & AI Factories vertical. By combining deep technical fluency with strategic storytelling, you will translate complex technologies such as power systems, cooling, automation, and digital twins into credible, value-driven narratives and assets that empower sales teams, partners, and customers.

Key Responsibilities

- Content Creation & Storytelling: Architect and produce high-impact technical assets including white papers, solution briefs, reference architectures, technical presentations, and demos that articulate Siemens’ business and technical value.

- Sales & Partner Enablement: Build sales tools (talk tracks, FAQs, competitive guides, discovery questions) and co-deliver training programs, workshops, and launch materials to prepare sellers and ecosystem partners.

- Technical Validation: Collaborate with SMEs, engineers, and solution architects to validate technical claims, benchmarks, simulations, and proofs of value for accuracy and credibility.

- Cross-Functional Bridge: Serve as the bridge between technical teams, product management, sales, marketing, and partners to ensure consistent, appropriate audience messaging.

- Optimization & Innovation: Leverage feedback, performance data analytics, and emerging approaches (including generative AI and interactive media) to continuously improve content quality and relevance.

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

raw.title: Senior Manager, SEO/AEO (AI Search)
raw.description:
Reports to: Eric Siu, CEO
Type: Full-time, client-facing player-coach. Not a people-manager seat.
Clients: an assigned book of Single Grain SEO/AEO accounts
Location: Full-time, remote, with at least 4 hours of US time-zone overlap
Comp: $100,000–$150,000 USD / year

## One-liner

Get Single Grain clients cited in AI answers and growing qualified organic pipeline, with agents doing most of the production.

## About the role

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. Search is splitting between Google and answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), and buyers now build their shortlist before they click. This seat owns SEO and AEO for an assigned set of client accounts: what to ship, why, and how we will know it worked.

You are the client's organic strategist and you stay hands-on. You set the roadmap, you build the agents that do the production, and you report citations and pipeline, not ranking screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. You will work inside Single Brain (our agent operating layer) and ClickFlow (our AI content-optimization platform), and build your own workflows in tools like Claude Code. Use AI for research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, and reporting, and check what it produces before anything ships.

## What you will own

- 

Diagnose each client's search demand, answer-engine visibility, technical health, content system, and conversion path; set baselines and targets.

- 

Own the SEO/AEO roadmap for your accounts and decide what ships next.

- 

Track answer-engine citations: a fixed prompt set per client, run weekly across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, logging where the client and its competitors are cited.

- 

Build and maintain the agents that do production (research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, reporting) and get teammates using them.

- 

Keep brief-to-publish under five working days, with a human check on facts, brand, and technical accuracy.

- 

Lead client strategy calls with proactive recommendations; give writers, developers, and analysts clear acceptance criteria.

- 

Report monthly in terms a GM would use: citations, qualified organic traffic, and pipeline or revenue where attribution allows.

- 

Write runbooks so the system runs without you at the keyboard.

## What success looks like

- 

By day 30: client diagnoses done; baselines set for citations and qualified organic pipeline; your AI citation tracker is live and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.

- 

By day 60: an agent-built brief-to-publish pipeline is running on every account; the monthly citation + pipeline report is in use with clients.

- 

By day 90: brief-to-publish under five working days; at least one account up on answer-engine citations or qualified organic pipeline vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = content volume going up with no citation or pipeline readback.

- 

By 6–12 months: citations and qualified organic pipeline up across your book; workflows do 70%+ of production; clients treat you as their go-to marketing strategist; you have designed yourself out of the daily queue.

## Evidence we want to see

- 

6+ years in SEO or organic growth, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, with client-facing ownership.

- 

Shipped answer-engine or AI-for-SEO work we can inspect: the pages, the citations, and how you measured them.

- 

One agent or workflow you built and still maintain that removed real production work: inputs, outputs, QA, and the result.

- 

One quantified result (citations, qualified traffic, pipeline, or revenue) with the baseline, period, and how you attributed it.

- 

AI fluency you can show: how answer engines retrieve and cite sources, and which calls you still make yourself.

- 

Strong technical SEO, analytics, and prioritization judgment.

- 

Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).

- 

Ideal: specialist search agency or an in-house growth team that ships; B2B.

## What this role is not

Not a content-volume role. Not vendor management or QC-only. Not a strategy-only seat that hands implementation to someone else. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users.

## How the process works

Application → 7 short questions sent to you by email → evidence review → live working session (diagnose a site → propose the AEO plan → measurement plan) → paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense → references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

## Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

## Apply

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.

employer_jobposting.description:
Reports to: Eric Siu, CEO
Type: Full-time, client-facing player-coach. Not a people-manager seat.
Clients: an assigned book of Single Grain SEO/AEO accounts
Location: Full-time, remote, with at least 4 hours of US time-zone overlap
Comp: $100,000–$150,000 USD / year

One-liner

Get Single Grain clients cited in AI answers and growing qualified organic pipeline, with agents doing most of the production.

About the role

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. Search is splitting between Google and answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), and buyers now build their shortlist before they click. This seat owns SEO and AEO for an assigned set of client accounts: what to ship, why, and how we will know it worked.

You are the client's organic strategist and you stay hands-on. You set the roadmap, you build the agents that do the production, and you report citations and pipeline, not ranking screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. You will work inside Single Brain (our agent operating layer) and ClickFlow (our AI content-optimization platform), and build your own workflows in tools like Claude Code. Use AI for research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, and reporting, and check what it produces before anything ships.

What you will own

  • Diagnose each client's search demand, answer-engine visibility, technical health, content system, and conversion path; set baselines and targets.

  • Own the SEO/AEO roadmap for your accounts and decide what ships next.

  • Track answer-engine citations: a fixed prompt set per client, run weekly across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, logging where the client and its competitors are cited.

  • Build and maintain the agents that do production (research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, reporting) and get teammates using them.

  • Keep brief-to-publish under five working days, with a human check on facts, brand, and technical accuracy.

  • Lead client strategy calls with proactive recommendations; give writers, developers, and analysts clear acceptance criteria.

  • Report monthly in terms a GM would use: citations, qualified organic traffic, and pipeline or revenue where attribution allows.

  • Write runbooks so the system runs without you at the keyboard.

What success looks like

  • By day 30: client diagnoses done; baselines set for citations and qualified organic pipeline; your AI citation tracker is live and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.

  • By day 60: an agent-built brief-to-publish pipeline is running on every account; the monthly citation + pipeline report is in use with clients.

  • By day 90: brief-to-publish under five working days; at least one account up on answer-engine citations or qualified organic pipeline vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = content volume going up with no citation or pipeline readback.

  • By 6–12 months: citations and qualified organic pipeline up across your book; workflows do 70%+ of production; clients treat you as their go-to marketing strategist; you have designed yourself out of the daily queue.

Evidence we want to see

  • 6+ years in SEO or organic growth, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, with client-facing ownership.

  • Shipped answer-engine or AI-for-SEO work we can inspect: the pages, the citations, and how you measured them.

  • One agent or workflow you built and still maintain that removed real production work: inputs, outputs, QA, and the result.

  • One quantified result (citations, qualified traffic, pipeline, or revenue) with the baseline, period, and how you attributed it.

  • AI fluency you can show: how answer engines retrieve and cite sources, and which calls you still make yourself.

  • Strong technical SEO, analytics, and prioritization judgment.

  • Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).

  • Ideal: specialist search agency or an in-house growth team that ships; B2B.

What this role is not

Not a content-volume role. Not vendor management or QC-only. Not a strategy-only seat that hands implementation to someone else. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users.

How the process works

Application → 7 short questions sent to you by email → evidence review → live working session (diagnose a site → propose the AEO plan → measurement plan) → paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense → references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

Apply

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.

raw.description:
## Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

Top Dog Law is one of the fastest-growing personal injury law firms in the country. Our decision science team turns data into decisions that move the business, not reports that sit in a folder. We're seeking a Senior Analyst to partner with our Client Marketing team and help us better understand, communicate with, and retain our clients.

The ideal candidate is a senior-level data analyst who is as comfortable writing complex SQL as they are explaining what the numbers mean to a marketing stakeholder. You will own the measurement behind how clients engage with Top Dog Law and use it to recommend what to change, what to scale, and what to stop.

What You Will Own

Client Marketing Analytics

- 
Track and interpret client performance to understand adoption, engagement, and opportunities to improve the client experience

- 
Report on and analyze metrics that drive client retention and engagement across the case lifecycle, including early indicators of disengagement and risk

- 
Evaluate email and SMS performance to sharpen how, when, and what we communicate to clients

- 
Measure and refine review generation strategies to grow the volume and quality of client reviews

- 
Design and evaluate tests, and translate findings into clear recommendations for Client Marketing

Reporting & Decision Support

- 
Write and maintain SQL that powers client marketing reporting and analysis

- 
Build and maintain dashboards that surface actionable insights for Client Marketing

- 
Prepare regular performance updates covering goals, results, and forward-looking recommendations

- 
Gather and monitor NPS data

- 
Use AI tools, including Claude, to build workflows and accelerate analysis

- 
Partner with data engineering and the broader decision science team to improve data quality and trust in the numbers

What You Bring

Required:

- 
5+ years of experience in an analytics or data analyst role, with a track record of influencing business decisions

- 
Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, CTEs, and window functions

- 
Experience with web, email, SMS analytics and NPS

- 
Experience analyzing CRM data (Salesforce)

- 
Experience using AI tools such as Claude to accelerate analysis and improve your work

- 
Strong fundamentals in experimentation and statistics, including A/B testing and segmentation

- 
Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear story for non-technical stakeholders

- 
Proven problem-solver who proactively identifies issues, diagnoses root causes, and acts without waiting to be directed

Preferred (Nice to Have):

- 
Experience with Braze or a comparable customer engagement platform

- 
Experience in client retention, customer lifecycle, or customer experience analytics

- 
Experience with review generation or online reputation management

- 
Experience in legal, insurance, or other service-based industries

- 
Familiarity with modern BI and dashboarding tools

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

- 
Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"

- 
Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.

- 
No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.

- 
Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.

- 
Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

- 
Base Salary: $105,000 - $129,000, commensurate with experience

- 
Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.

- 
Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

DISCLAIMER: Each TopDog Law affiliated entity may use may use artificial intelligence (AI) and automated decision-making tools to assist in screening and evaluating candidates for employment positions, including whether to advance a candidate in the application process. raw.title: Affiliate Marketing Manager
raw.description:
Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list. 

 

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com.

 

Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We need an Affiliates Marketing Manager to help grow and manage Pattern's affiliate programs across major online marketplaces like Amazon and Walmart — building affiliate networks, running campaigns, and keeping brand partners informed on performance. It's a brand-facing role where you'll get to work with a wide range of well-known brands across industries like CPG, beauty, and wellness, so the work never gets stale even though the core process stays consistent. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule based in Lehi.

\n

What is a day in the life of an Affiliate Marketing Manager?

- 

Research and reach out to potential affiliates and creators across marketplace platforms (Amazon, Walmart, and others)

- 

Build, launch, and manage affiliate campaigns, including setting and monitoring budgets

- 

Serve as a brand-facing point of contact, providing regular reporting, strategy, and program updates to partners

- 

Monitor overall affiliate program health and budgets across marketplace retailers and proactively flag issues

- 

Build and grow affiliate networks, crafting messaging and strategies to engage affiliates

- 

Use affiliate platforms such as Levanta and Impact (or similar tools) to manage campaigns across retailers

What will I need to thrive in this role?

- 

2-5+ years of relevant marketing experience, ideally in affiliate marketing, marketplace management, or an agency setting

- 

Hands-on experience with marketplace affiliate programs such as Amazon or Walmart

- 

A clear understanding of how affiliate programs function: building affiliate networks, creating campaigns, and managing budgets

- 

Strong executive and business presence, with the polish and terminology to represent Pattern directly to brand partners face-to-face

- 

Proven ability to multitask and manage a high volume of brand accounts at once (agency experience managing 40+ accounts is a plus)

- 

Familiarity with affiliate platforms like Levanta or Impact is a bonus, though not required — these are learnable on the job

- 

Background in CPG, pharmaceuticals, vitamins/minerals/supplements, or beauty is a plus (not required)

- 

Background in Amazon advertising a plus

What does high performance look like?

- 

You build strong, trusted relationships with your brand partners and are seen as a reliable point of contact

- 

You independently manage a large, varied portfolio of brands and proactively monitor and resolve program health issues

- 

Some examples might include these:

- 

You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner

- 

Ability to work cross functionally between both internal and external teams

- 

You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given

- 

You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion 

What is the team like?

You will work alongside other members of the Marketplaces team, and be managed by our Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

Sounds great! What’s the company culture?

We are looking for individuals who are:

- 

Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.

- 

Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.

- 

Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.

- 

Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

- 

Initial phone screen with Pattern's talent acquisition team

- 

Screening interview focused on general marketplace understanding and business acumen

- 

Topgrading interview with the hiring manager

- 

Final round and professional 

- 

Reference Checks

- 

Executive approval

- 

Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

- 

Speak specifically to your experience with marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Walmart, etc.) — not just social/creator platforms

- 

Share data or examples of managing a high volume of brand or client accounts at once

- 

Highlight your business acumen and comfort presenting directly to brand partners/clients

- 

Mention any experience with CPG, pharma, vitamins/supplements, or beauty brands, or with affiliate platforms like Levanta or Impact

\n

Why should I work at Pattern?

 

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

 

- Unlimited PTO

- Paid Holidays

- Onsite Fitness Center

- Company Paid Life Insurance

- Casual Dress Code

- Competitive Pay

- Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

- 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred. 

 

Pattern provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

document.full_description_markdown:
Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list. 

 

Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com.

 

Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We need an Affiliates Marketing Manager to help grow and manage Pattern's affiliate programs across major online marketplaces like Amazon and Walmart — building affiliate networks, running campaigns, and keeping brand partners informed on performance. It's a brand-facing role where you'll get to work with a wide range of well-known brands across industries like CPG, beauty, and wellness, so the work never gets stale even though the core process stays consistent. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule based in Lehi.

\n

What is a day in the life of an Affiliate Marketing Manager?

- 

Research and reach out to potential affiliates and creators across marketplace platforms (Amazon, Walmart, and others)

- 

Build, launch, and manage affiliate campaigns, including setting and monitoring budgets

- 

Serve as a brand-facing point of contact, providing regular reporting, strategy, and program updates to partners

- 

Monitor overall affiliate program health and budgets across marketplace retailers and proactively flag issues

- 

Build and grow affiliate networks, crafting messaging and strategies to engage affiliates

- 

Use affiliate platforms such as Levanta and Impact (or similar tools) to manage campaigns across retailers

What will I need to thrive in this role?

- 

2-5+ years of relevant marketing experience, ideally in affiliate marketing, marketplace management, or an agency setting

- 

Hands-on experience with marketplace affiliate programs such as Amazon or Walmart

- 

A clear understanding of how affiliate programs function: building affiliate networks, creating campaigns, and managing budgets

- 

Strong executive and business presence, with the polish and terminology to represent Pattern directly to brand partners face-to-face

- 

Proven ability to multitask and manage a high volume of brand accounts at once (agency experience managing 40+ accounts is a plus)

- 

Familiarity with affiliate platforms like Levanta or Impact is a bonus, though not required — these are learnable on the job

- 

Background in CPG, pharmaceuticals, vitamins/minerals/supplements, or beauty is a plus (not required)

- 

Background in Amazon advertising a plus

What does high performance look like?

- 

You build strong, trusted relationships with your brand partners and are seen as a reliable point of contact

- 

You independently manage a large, varied portfolio of brands and proactively monitor and resolve program health issues

- 

Some examples might include these:

- 

You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner

- 

Ability to work cross functionally between both internal and external teams

- 

You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given

- 

You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion 

What is the team like?

You will work alongside other members of the Marketplaces team, and be managed by our Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

Sounds great! What’s the company culture?

We are looking for individuals who are:

- 

Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.

- 

Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.

- 

Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations, and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.

- 

Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of a team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

- 

Initial phone screen with Pattern's talent acquisition team

- 

Screening interview focused on general marketplace understanding and business acumen

- 

Topgrading interview with the hiring manager

- 

Final round and professional 

- 

Reference Checks

- 

Executive approval

- 

Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

- 

Speak specifically to your experience with marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Walmart, etc.) — not just social/creator platforms

- 

Share data or examples of managing a high volume of brand or client accounts at once

- 

Highlight your business acumen and comfort presenting directly to brand partners/clients

- 

Mention any experience with CPG, pharma, vitamins/supplements, or beauty brands, or with affiliate platforms like Levanta or Impact

\n

Why should I work at Pattern?

 

Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:

 

- Unlimited PTO

- Paid Holidays

- Onsite Fitness Center

- Company Paid Life Insurance

- Casual Dress Code

- Competitive Pay

- Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

- 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred. 

 

Pattern provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Research and reach out to potential affiliates and creators across marketplace platforms (Amazon, Walmart, and others)

Build, launch, and manage affiliate campaigns, including setting and monitoring budgets

You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner

raw.title: Senior Manager, Paid Media (AI-First)
raw.description:
Reports to: Eric Siu, CEO
Type: Full-time, hands-on player-coach. Client-facing. Not a people-manager seat.
Clients: an assigned book of Single Grain paid media accounts (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, programmatic)
Location: Full-time, remote (United States or Latin America; at least 4 hours of US overlap; professional English)
Comp: $100,000–$150,000 USD / year, depending on location

## One-liner

Own paid growth for a book of Single Grain clients as their performance strategist, and build the AI workflows that take build-outs, reporting, and QA off your plate.

## About the role

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. This seat runs paid search, paid social, and programmatic for an assigned set of client accounts. You still get your hands in the accounts; your agents do most of the production. Clients treat you as their growth strategist: you tell them what to test next, and you tie spend to pipeline and revenue, not ROAS screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. The platforms already run on automation (Performance Max, Meta Advantage+, smart bidding); you know when to trust it and when to override it. On top of that you build your own agents for build-outs, pacing, reporting, creative iteration, and QA, and you check their output before it touches client spend.

## What you will own

- 

Diagnose each client's paid program; set baselines and targets (CAC, ROAS, CPL, qualified pipeline, revenue) and own the plan.

- 

Run and optimize accounts across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and programmatic within approved budgets.

- 

Ship test cycles fast: from idea to first readout in under five working days.

- 

Run an account health + QA agent on every account: weekly pacing, anomaly flags (spend spikes, broken tracking, disapprovals), and next-test recommendations.

- 

Run AI creative iteration: generate ad and landing-page variants, test them, and keep a human brand and claims check before anything goes live.

- 

Lead client strategy calls and bring proactive recommendations every month.

- 

Report monthly in terms a GM would use: spend tied to pipeline and revenue, with baselines.

- 

Write runbooks so the work does not depend on you being at the keyboard.

## What success looks like

- 

By day 30: client diagnoses done; baselines and targets agreed; your account health + QA agent is live on your accounts and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.

- 

By day 60: test cycles running on every account; AI creative iteration live on at least one account; monthly reporting ties spend to pipeline or revenue.

- 

By day 90: launch-to-learn under five working days; at least one account showing measurable CAC, ROAS, or pipeline improvement vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = tests still launched without a hypothesis, baseline, or readout.

- 

By 6–12 months: client programs hit their agreed targets; workflows do 70%+ of paid production; you have designed yourself out of the daily build queue.

## Evidence we want to see

- 

About 5+ years in digital paid media, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, and still running accounts yourself, with spend scale.

- 

One paid result with the metric, baseline, period, and how you attributed it.

- 

One AI workflow or agent you built that removed real paid production work, and what it changed.

- 

AI fluency you can show: the workflow's inputs, outputs, and controls, and how you check agent or platform-automation output before it touches spend.

- 

Client-facing strategy: examples where you set the plan, not just executed tickets.

- 

Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).

- 

Ideal: growth/performance agency, B2B SaaS lead gen, or multi-client experience.

## What this role is not

Not a media buyer or ticket-taker. Not vendor management only. Not TV, OOH, or print planning. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users. Not a fit if freelancing, consulting, or your own agency is your main work today.

## How the process works

Application → 7 short questions sent to you by email → evidence review → live working session (diagnose an account → propose tests → measurement plan) → paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense → references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

## Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

## Apply

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.
